activation.requires: an explicit later policy decision by James; nothing here activates it

purpose: Prospective observation only. This is NOT a nomination for deployment. The retrospective evidence cannot separate this candidate from the control, so it is registered so that a forward sample can be collected against a frozen definition.

unchanged: the 15-minute final-pregame cutoff and decision timing
complete same-book two-sided moneyline quote requirement
confirmed / probable-stable starter rules and the 2.0 pt starter penalty
lineup treatment and the 0.5 pt lineup penalty
quarter-Kelly staking, the tier position caps, the 50% penalised-evidence multiplier

exclusions.readiness_threshold_change: NOT part of this candidate. The control applies no composite readiness threshold, so there is nothing to lower.
exclusions.feature_completeness_veto_exception: NOT part of this candidate. No such veto exists; R3/R4 were diagnostics only and are not deployable settings.
exclusions.market_scope_change: NOT part of this candidate. Moneyline only, as today.

comparison_metrics.primary: unit-stake profit per settled marginal selection
comparison_metrics.guardrail: the candidate must not worsen Brier or log loss versus the control

evidence_requirements.blocking_prerequisite: Odds ingestion must be restored. 63 of 99 control non-selections are price availability, so at the current data rate the required sample would take roughly a full additional season to accumulate.
must_not: re-run the same 2026-09-01..2026-09-08 window with more configurations
treat repeated evaluations of one event as independent observations
declare an optimum from fewer than the minimum sample

risk_note: Every difference between this candidate and the control in the retrospective cohort rests on a single settled event. Activating on that basis would be curve-fitting to one baseball game.
